description: This file defines a class for compiling user-defined template call tags in the Smarty templating engine. It handles attributes, caching considerations, and generates PHP code to invoke template functions.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Call
classes.description: A compiler class for handling {function} calls in Smarty templates, generating PHP code to invoke template functions with attribute processing and caching logic.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the Smarty {function} call tag into executable PHP code, handling attributes, optional variables, and caching flags.
